turns.sql:
SELECT
    pub.publisher_name,
    sh.superhero_name,
    COALESCE(attr.total_attribute, 0) AS total_attribute,
    COALESCE(pwr.power_count, 0) AS power_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY sh.publisher_id
        ORDER BY COALESCE(attr.total_attribute, 0) DESC, COALESCE(pwr.power_count, 0) DESC
    ) AS rank_within_publisher
FROM superhero sh
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, SUM(attribute_value) AS total_attribute
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
) attr ON attr.hero_id = sh.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) pwr ON pwr.hero_id = sh.id
LEFT JOIN publisher pub ON pub.id = sh.publisher_id
ORDER BY pub.publisher_name, rank_within_publisher;

),

  SELECT h.id AS hero_id

    SELECT 1 FROM combat_attr ca

    WHERE ha.attribute_value IS NULL OR ha.attribute_value < 90

)
